title: The Hours
author: Michael Cunningham
summary: Three women in three eras share a single day linked to Virginia Woolf's Mrs Dalloway: Woolf herself, a 1950s housewife and a present-day New Yorker planning a party. Their stories begin to echo one another.
readIf: you like quiet, beautifully made novels that spend a lot of time inside characters' thoughts.
skipIf: you want much plot, or you are looking for an upbeat read.

pairings.reason: The book it was written in response to; reading it first adds a great deal.
Another American novel about friendship and the weight of private pain, far longer and harsher.
Another elegant study of ordinary lives, grief and loneliness in plain, compelling prose.
